revenue_scope: Worldwide reported sales of the 'Premix insulin' therapy-class line, which also holds NovoMix, DKK
why_separate: From 2026Q1 Novo Nordisk no longer prints Ryzodeg 70/30 on its own row; it sits in the 'Premix insulin' line, which also holds NovoMix, so the figure is a class total and not Ryzodeg 70/30's own sales.
notes: Reported sales are recorded, as in the gold series; Q1 2026 reported sales include a one-off 340B provision reversal booked in the US (adjusted sales excluding it are the third quoted figure). The line is shared with the other brands named in line_includes.
search_log: listed all CIK 0000353278 filings via data.sec.gov/submissions: Novo Nordisk is a foreign private issuer (6-K/20-F), so the quarterly financial reports are 6-K exhibits named caq{q}{yyyy}.htm; fetched caq12026.htm (0000353278-26-000018) and caq22026.htm (0000353278-26-000023) from sec.gov Archives

grepped the full text and every table of the Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 reports for the brand names: the brand appears in running text and in a footnote of a therapy-class row only; no table row is labelled with the brand (Sales split per therapy, Sales split per region/area, Adjusted sales split per area, Appendix 6 IFRS reconciliation: all list therapy-class lines)
the last report printing the brand as its own row is caq42025.htm (0000353278-26-000006), already the end of the gold series

no partner or royalty holder checked separately: Novo Nordisk is the sole seller and reports worldwide; no Excel supplement or data book published by the issuer lists brand-level sales for 2026Q1-Q2 in the 6-K

continuation.evidence: Novo Nordisk Q1 2026 financial report (caq12026.htm), Appendix 6 'Sales split per therapy', row 'Premix insulin' with footnote: 'Comprises Ryzodeg ® and NovoMix ®.' - the brand has no row of its own.
